UNcommonVCU social plan

Calendar: what to post and what to do with the ads, Oct 16 to Dec 14. Picks: slide 1 of every post, day by day. Launch is Mon Oct 26. Updated Oct 24, 2026.

This is a suggested plan, not rules. It’s here to make posting easy: every post is picked, written and waiting in its folder. Post what you want, when you want.

How to use it

  • The small gold line under a post says which persona it’s written for (Maya the student, Denise the Richmond mom, Alanna the recent alum) and what it asks people to do. It’s for us: it never goes on the post. Each week’s header counts the posts written for each.
  • Find today. Post is a suggestion for Instagram. The gray line under it is its folder in the Social Team folder (open the week, then the day), and the italic line is what the post says.
  • Two or three posts a day: three through launch week and on the big days, four on the opener. Game days also get a “come with me” story card. Morning, midday and evening are only suggestions.
  • Reels are the videos. They can go on Instagram and TikTok. The coach videos are marked when Coldon says it’s cleared because he’s fixing the b-roll. Evan approved the photos and the players’ answers on Oct 15.
  • About once a week there’s an open Extra Tiny Mic Reel (if ready) slot. Teammates are cutting more Tiny Mic Q&A Reels; if one is ready, post it there. If not, skip it.
  • One-off posts (like Armani’s first-post poster) can go in any day.
  • Posts in the library that aren’t on the calendar are listed under Spares at the end. Swap one in any day.
  • Feed posts can go in Stories too. Ads only shows up on days something changes.

What we’re posting from

  • Coldon’s coach interview (locked): the full long-form interview, the 60-second version for posting, and two vertical shorts, “An Invitation” and “Fan Attendance”. All of them wait until Coldon says they’re cleared.
  • Tiny Mic: Gabby’s three player-interview videos, plus nine stills that quote them (Ada, Ann, Daija and Nicole, word for word). More Tiny Mic Q&A Reels are being cut for the open slots.
  • The stills library: the post batch in Social Outputs (tweet cards, text and photo carousels, photo dumps, quizzes, countdown, gameday and final-score posts).
  • The ads use the same pieces, videos first.

The money, start to finish ($200)

  • Mon Oct 26 Launch. Google starts at $2.40 a day. Meta launch ads start: $25 over 10 days (about $2.50 a day).
  • Wed Nov 4 Meta launch ads end at 11:59 PM ($25 spent). Google: remove the “Nov 3” headlines.
  • Thu Nov 5 Meta game ads start: $75 through NC Central tip-off on Nov 16 (12 days, about $6.25 a day).
  • Thu Nov 12 Google goes up to $4.80 a day for the five days before NC Central.
  • Mon Nov 16 Meta ends at tip-off ($100 spent). Google turns on the “Watch” ad group.
  • Tue Nov 17 Google back down to $2.40 a day.
  • Mon Nov 30 Google stops at 11:59 PM (about $98 spent). Everything is off.

Why Meta runs so long: it starts with no data, and it needs time to learn who clicks. Long, steady runs learn better than short bursts, so the $25 runs 10 days and the $75 runs 12, the shortest runs that still give it time to learn. Every edit restarts the learning, so build each set of ads once and leave it alone.

Why the Google budget doubles Nov 12–16: Meta can put most of its money on the NC Central game, but Google only spends when people search, so it can’t. Raising its daily limit for the five days before the game is the closest thing. Running $2.40 the rest of the time keeps the total at about $100.

How to

The steps the calendar points to.

If launch slips past Mon Oct 26

  1. Google doesn’t depend on the posts, so it starts Oct 26 regardless.
  2. The three Oct 26 posts (Who we are, Meet coach Banbury, Day One) make a good first day whenever it is. Then pick the calendar up on that date.
  3. Days before launch are skipped. Their posts mostly point at Nov 3, so they only fit before the opener; if one fits, swap it in for a later pre-opener post.
  4. Meta: if the launch ads can’t start by Oct 26, don’t run a separate short launch flight (under 10 days doesn’t give Meta time to learn). Run one $100 set from the start day to NC Central tip-off (Nov 16) with all the ads: the launch videos and the game ads. Build it once, then leave it alone.

Approvals (as of Oct 21)

  1. Evan (VCU Athletics) approved the Athletics photos and the players’ answers on Oct 15. Keep the “VCU Athletics” credit visible on every photo slide.
  2. That covers the Tiny Mic videos and the 9 stills that quote them word for word.
  3. Still waiting: Coldon’s coach videos (the full interview, the 60-second version and the two vertical cuts). He’s fixing the b-roll. Post them when Coldon says they’re cleared.
  4. Everything else in the post batch is our own words or public facts.

Site steps

  1. Site headshots (if not on yet): Appearance → Customize → Player photos → tick “Show player headshots” → Publish.
  2. Add the “add when approved” lines from HANDOFF/pivot-page-copy.md (How it works and the FAQ). Pages → open the page → Edit → paste → Update.
  3. When Coldon says the coach interview is cleared: Media → Add New → upload the 60-second version → copy its File URL. Then The Board → Settings → Coach interview → paste it into Video URL → check that “Detected” recognises it → tick “Show on the site” → Save.

Instagram + TikTok setup

  1. Both accounts are set up (Armani). Profile photo: Brand/uncommonvcu-logo-512.png. Name: UNcommonVCU. The bio has to say it’s an unofficial student fan site.
  2. Bio links: Instagram bio = uncommonvcu.com/ig, TikTok bio = uncommonvcu.com/tiktok (the site counts the taps from each).
  3. Then on the site: Appearance → Customize → Social links → paste the Instagram URL and the TikTok URL → Publish.
  4. TikTok: the videos (Reels) can go there the same day as Instagram.

Google setup (build by Oct 23, starts Oct 26)

  1. Link GA4 (Grayson): the link needs one person with Editor on GA4 and Admin on Google Ads, so Prof. Sarma adds Grayson as a Google Ads Admin first (Admin → Access and security → + → Admin). Then in GA4: Admin → Product links → Google Ads links → Link → choose the account → leave personalized advertising and auto-tagging on → Submit. The ads team imports the conversions the next day.
  2. Negative keywords: Tools → Shared library → Exclusion lists → + → name it “UNcommonVCU negatives” → paste the list from the Google Ads package (Ads Team › Packages).
  3. Conversions: Goals → + Create conversion action → Import → Google Analytics 4 → tick uvb_account_claimed, uvb_checkin_success, uvb_ticket_click. Make account_claimed Primary, the other two Secondary.
  4. New campaign → Search → name it “ue-launch”. Untick search partners and the Display Network. Turn off the AI Max options.
  5. Location: 15 miles around 1200 W Broad St, Richmond. Location options → “people in or regularly in”.
  6. Budget $2.40 a day. Bidding: Maximize clicks, max cost per click $1.50. Start date Mon Oct 26, end date Mon Nov 30.
  7. Ad groups, keywords, headlines and descriptions: paste them from the Google Ads package. Build all three groups, then pause “Watch” until Nov 16 (every game before Nov 19 is at home).
  8. Attach the negatives list to the campaign.

Meta setup

  1. Check first (ask Prof. Sarma to fix anything missing): there’s a Facebook Page behind the account, Instagram is connected, the time zone is Eastern, the currency is USD, and the spending limit is $100.
  2. Always build in Ads Manager on a computer. Never use “Boost” on the phone.
  3. Every ad: objective Traffic → Maximize landing page views. Instagram only (Feed, Stories, Reels, Explore). Age 18+, suggest 18–24.
  4. Ads use only what we already have: the coach cuts, the Tiny Mic videos, and posts from the batch. Text and tracking tags for each ad are in the Meta ads package (Ads Team › Packages). Check the preview for cropping before publishing.
  5. Launch ads (“ue-launch”): $25 lifetime budget, Mon Oct 26 to the end of Wed Nov 4 (10 days), 5 miles around the Siegel Center. Ads: “An Invitation”, Tiny Mic #1 and Tiny Mic #2. “An Invitation” only if Coldon says it’s cleared by the time you build; if not, run the two Tiny Mic videos.
  6. If Ads Manager says the budget is too low for the dates (Meta’s floor is roughly $1 a day; check in the UI), move the end date earlier until it accepts.
  7. Don’t touch a running ad set: changing budget, targeting or ads restarts Meta’s learning. “Learning limited” is normal at this budget; ignore it.
  8. Launch links: the videos go to uncommonvcu.com/team/ with utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=paid-social&utm_campaign=ue-launch&utm_content=unguarded-coach-invitation (or unguarded-tinymic-1, unguarded-tinymic-2). The carousels go to uncommonvcu.com/play/ with utm_content=undecided-whoweare-carousel or unguarded-coach-carousel.
  9. Game ads (“ue-game-” plus the game key from The Board → Link builder → NC Central): $75 lifetime, Thu Nov 5 to tip-off (6 PM) Mon Nov 16 (12 days), 2 miles around the Siegel Center. Build them Sun Nov 1. Ads: “Fan Attendance” (if Coldon says it’s cleared), Tiny Mic #3, the best launch ad, and the “Monday night” text carousel (Social Team › Week 3 › Sun Nov 15; it posts on the feed that day too).
  10. Game-week links: uncommonvcu.com/gameday/ with utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=paid-social&utm_campaign=ue-game-<game key>&utm_content=unmissable-coach-fanattendance (or unguarded-tinymic-3, unmissable-mondaynight-carousel; the best launch ad keeps its launch utm_content).

Nov 4 headline cleanup (Google)

  1. Ad group “Team and coach”: remove “The Unlimited Era Starts Nov 3” and “Home Opener Tuesday, Nov 3”.
  2. Ad group “Game day”: remove “Home Opener Tuesday, Nov 3”.
  3. Nothing to add: each group still has 13 or 14 headlines from the batch.

Tuesday ad check (10 minutes, before class)

  1. Google: Insights and reports → Search terms. Add anything irrelevant to the negatives list. Then note clicks, cost per click and conversions, and take a screenshot.
  2. Meta (through Nov 17): amount spent, landing page views, cost per landing page view, frequency. Frequency over 3 means the same people keep seeing it; note it, but don’t edit mid-run unless it’s over 5. Screenshot.
  3. Write down the week’s spend on each platform next to the screenshots.
